name: Zenn Sorfield
original_name: ゼン・ソルフィールド
source:
[i]“Your blade'll never land a fatal blow on me. ...Wanna give it a try anyway?”[/i]

[i]The Isolated Hanged Man[/i]

A man whose family, birthplace, and even age remain shrouded in mystery. His large build and naturally fierce expression often inspire fear in others despite his own intent. Even his status as friend or foe remains entirely unknown to the heroine.

To understand just who Zenn is, she must make him an ally... but to make him in ally, she must expose his true identity.

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/tempest/english/characters/?page=zenn]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
